metadata.title: Clicked like I owed them a soda and somehow stole that 1 clueless kill?! Valorant logic fries my...
metadata.description:
Spam clicked like my mouse was begging for mercy.
Enemy probably raged to the shadow realm.
Pretending I meant that for 0.16 seconds.
Click if your aim’s a beautiful disaster but kills still happen!

Tap if your aim’s a glorious mess but the game still says YES!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
